slides.title: Global Transaction Banking Platform
bullets: End-to-End Architecture Blueprint
Confluence of Graph, Kinetic Layer, Streaming, and Real-Time Intelligence
For: Nexus Global

slides.title: Executive Summary
bullets: Canonical, ontology-driven GTB platform: one model across CB/CM/WM.
Goals: control, consistency, cross-LOB visibility, speed, regulatory readiness.
Pillar 1: Canonical graph (Neo4j) as single source of truth.
Pillar 2: Kinetic layer (PostgreSQL) — declared actions, rules, immutable proof.
Pillar 3: Streaming backbone (Confluent Cloud) + Flink on K8s.
Pillar 4: Analytics/history in Delta Lake; hot cache in Redis; fully governed.

slides.title: Dimension 1 — Logical Model
bullets: Canonical graph is the single source of truth.
Unified ontology across LOBs; no siloed definitions.
Core nodes: parties, products, accounts, transactions, mandates, vendors.
Interfaces define behavior across entity types (e.g., IIsSettlementTarget).
Vendor-hosted systems (TF/SCF) via Containment Zone with progressive mapping.

slides.title: Dimension 2 — Materialization Strategy
bullets: Neo4j: operational graph — traversals, ownership, entitlement checks.
PostgreSQL: kinetic layer + mandates + append-only proof registry.
Delta Lake (Databricks): analytics, history, LOB projections, containment zone.
Redis: hot cache for entitlements, mandates, high-frequency lookups.
Cross-store sync via CDC (Confluent); graph is always the source of truth.

slides.title: Dimension 3 — Platform Infrastructure
bullets: Confluent Cloud (Dedicated): canonical streaming backbone.
Flink on K8s (AKS): stateful stream computing, CEP, forecasting.
Neo4j + PostgreSQL: optimized for graph traversal and ACID kinetic workloads.
Databricks/Delta Lake: analytics, history, regulatory reports.
Azure-native: private endpoints, TLS, Unity Catalog governance.

slides.title: Dimension 4 — API & Integration Contract
bullets: Entity Platform API is the sole write path to the canonical platform.
Endpoints are ontology actions (InitiatePayment, ExecuteFXForward, etc.), not raw CRUD.
Every write includes a proof payload; rejected if missing or invalid.
Async via Confluent: domain, kinetic, vendor, governance events.
LOBs and partners integrate via API (sync) + governed Kafka topics (async).

slides.title: Dimension 5 — Governance, Trust, Mandates
bullets: Mandate hierarchy: HumanMandate → SystemMandate → AgentMandate.
No agent action executes without a valid mandate and intact delegation chain.
Proof registry: append-only, SHA-256 chained; every edge has an evidentiary trail.
All kinetic and Flink decisions logged as governance.audit-events.
Fully reconstructible for regulators and internal audits.

slides.title: Stream Computing: Flink at a Glance
bullets: Flink runs on Kubernetes; connected to Confluent and Databricks.
Purpose: stateful, real-time computation across payments, ledger, vendors, actions.
Joins streams with graph and reference data.
Enforces rules in motion; produces incidents, alerts, forecasts, liquidity signals.
Not 'dumb pipes'; the nervous system of the platform.

slides.title: Flink Use Case: Reporting (Regulatory + Operational)
bullets: Real-time aggregation of payments, ledger, and trade events.
Enriched with canonical entity/relationship context.
Produces reporting-ready streams into Delta Lake (tb_canonical.reporting).
Enables BCBS-239-aligned reporting, audits, and regulatory submissions.

slides.title: Flink Use Case: Statements (Payments + Ledger)
bullets: Real-time assembly of statement lines per customer/account from payments and ledger events.
Handles postings, fees, interest, reversals, and adjustments consistently.
Ensures per-entity ordering and idempotency.
Supports transparent, regulator-ready statements from immutable event streams.

slides.title: Flink Use Case: Cash Flow Forecasting
bullets: Near-real-time projected cash flows from payments, trades, vendor events.
Per-entity, per-product horizons: T+0/T+1/T+7/T+30.
Feeds forecasts into Delta Lake for Treasury and analytics.
Triggers alerts when forecasts breach predefined thresholds.

slides.title: Flink Use Case: Liquidity Monitoring
bullets: Continuous liquidity positions per entity, pool, currency.
Detects breaches and concentration anomalies via rolling windows.
Emits governance alerts and kinetic actions (e.g., sweeps, limits).
Aligned with existing pool, sweep, and facility ontology.

slides.title: End-to-End Architecture Blueprint
bullets: One integrated, governance-hardened platform across all layers.
From canonical graph to kinetic actions, streaming, and real-time decisions.

slides.title: How It All Fits Together
bullets: One ontology, one platform — shared canonical graph across all LOBs.
Actions, not CRUD — declared operations with proof, rules, and governance.
Streaming + Flink as the nervous system — real-time correlation and decisions.
Governance and trust baked in — mandates, audit, and reconstructibility by design.
